name: claude-config
description: Plugins vendored in the claude-config repo, loaded in place from the deployed ~/.claude/mods

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode: YAGNI ladder, stdlib first, shortest working diff. DietrichGebert/ponytail 4.8.4 at 16f2980 (MIT).

plugins.name: vibe-wise
plugins.description: Learning mode per project: you design, Claude explains and writes the agreed code. nykooi1/vibe-wise 0.1.43 at c5fc8d8 (MIT).

plugins.name: usage-scoped
plugins.description: Weekly per-model rate-limit windows written to ~/.claude/.usage-scoped for the statusline's Week <model> segments; the engine holds the credential. Local mod (MIT).
